class.name: BambooCore
class.description: Singleton exposing the Bamboo product version, which is independent from the Godot base version reported by [method Engine.get_version_info].

method.name: get_codename
method.description: Returns the codename of the current Bamboo release line, e.g. [code]"Sprout"[/code].

method.name: get_godot_base_version
method.description: Returns the Godot base version this Bamboo build is based on, e.g. [code]"4.8.dev"[/code].

method.name: get_version_info
method.description: Returns a dictionary with the keys [code]major[/code], [code]minor[/code], [code]patch[/code], [code]prerelease[/code], [code]codename[/code], [code]string[/code] and [code]godot_base[/code].

method.name: get_version_string
method.description: Returns the Bamboo version string, e.g. [code]"0.1.0-alpha.1"[/code].
